prompt: An organization wants its 40 repositories to start from the same hardened CI template. Where do the template files live?
explanation: Workflow templates for an organization live in its `.github` repository inside `workflow-templates/`, each with a metadata file that controls how it appears in the New workflow list. Repositories then start from one maintained source instead of forty copies.

options.text: In each repository, synced by hand
In a special branch of every repository named `templates`
